description: compost stop-guard: during a compost:implement run, a stop that waits on the user for anything but an allowed stop is sent back to post a ruling and continue. verify-gate: a git push or PR create from Bash whose HEAD has no compost:verify stamp (scripts/stamp.py) is logged to ~/.claude/verify-gate/log.jsonl; COMPOST_VERIFY_GATE picks observe (the default: log only), enforce (block twice per session, then let the next through as a bypass), or off. skill-drift: after each turn that loaded a skill, Jev judges the turn for skill drift and hits go to ~/.claude/skill-drift/. architecture-review: compost:deepen shows its deepening candidates as cards in a pane.
